## What and why

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] API change? Ran `make api-schema` and committed the regenerated contract
- [ ] New tenant-owned table? RLS enabled and a tenant-isolation test added
- [ ] New scanner check? Marked passive vs verified-only, and added unit tests
- [ ] Threat model (docs/threat-model.md) updated if a trust boundary changed
- [ ] ADR added for any significant design decision
